# sh-list-info

**Purpose:** One profile detail row: sh-icon (20) + text, optionally masked. Part of sh-list — place sh-list, pick Type=Info, edit under Row.

**Lines:** one or two lines (detail + supporting line). Content: plain text or a masked value (gold asterisks + lock).

**Rules:** masked rows always pair with Unlock in the section title.
